resources.string: Open full player when tapping a song
Off: start in mini-player. On: open Now Playing immediately.
Before setting your name or signing in to Google, choose the WireGuard or proxy connection used by BitChord. Importing a .conf will restart the app automatically.
After importing a .conf, tap OK to restart. You will then set your name and sign in.
BitChord will restart to apply the proxy settings.
